title: Guide very prepared, nice, helpful. He speaks very good Italian
text: Guide very prepared, nice, helpful. He speaks very good Italian highly recommended. A guarantee. Lucky to meet him
author: Gianluca C

title: On the must see list Seville
text:
If visiting Seville this must be on your list. It's a UNESCO building so it's not going to disappoint. Amazing cathedral. Huge Gothic style structure with the riches of the New World and the craftsmanship of the ages. Definitely the most impressive cathedral I've ever seen.

You'll need at least 2 hours and you'll need an audio guide. Signage is not good. It is hard to follow a route. This is the only negative.

Visit and enjoy
author: Summertours

title: An excellent guide in a spectacular place
text:
We did the guided tour in Italian with Andres, who proved to be super helpful with a very broad knowledge of the place
its history and curiosities... highly recommended!
author: emmina_milano

title: Seville Cathedral and Giralda
text: Imposing and majestic. Built on an ancient mosque. Dedicated to Santa Maria della Sede. It is considered one of the largest Gothic churches. Thanks to Andres, our prepared and competent, helpful and kind tour guide.

title: Super Fall in Love with Sevilla Tour !

title: Sevilla Catedral
text: Excellent tour with our guide Andreas. Great English, knowledgeable and personable. Made our tour interesting and endeared to show us the main areas of interest before it became too crowded. Highly recommended.
author: Spence1234

title: Small groups, friendly and spectacular treatment.
text: Wonderful personalized visit, in which not only the cathedral is explained in detail but is an open visit to receive questions and making it much more personal, care is taken to treat it spectacular and not only that but the groups are careful that they are small and looking for the opportune moments in each space so that they do not meet with other groups and can be upset.
author: 144maruxas

title: Outstanding tour!
text: Outstanding tour!! Pablo did an excellent job - he shared facts and info while keeping it interesting for my three kids (ages 15, 13, 10). We were the only ones on his tour so really easy to hear him and see everything.I had been to the cathedral before but I learned so much on the tour. Highly recommend!
